sortieLines.line: ⚔️ SORTIE — Miguel, Naran take up arms and a day's rations (4,007 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
⚔️ The Big Ugly mauled Miguel (-95 health) over 8 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing. — the party falls back to the palisade, dragging their nerve with them. The treeline holds.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Redactor gorges at the treeline — 600 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
